scope.task: Ninth-pass hunt for additional YC Summer 2026 first-party social evidence not already in src/lib/social/targeted-evidence-current.json.

policy.requiredAuthorType: company, founder, official account, or author verifiable through local YC identity

scope.prioritization: Focused on YC Summer 2026 companies with zero or sparse current evidence counts, then accepted only strict first-party native URLs with visible metrics.

searches.queryOrCommand: jq over src/lib/social/targeted-evidence-current.json and src/lib/yc/summer-2026-companies.json to count current evidence by S26 company.
